verdict.reasons: The image successfully illustrates the requested AFP drip-tape product and aligns perfectly with the agronomy topic of wheat irrigation. The commercial roll features authentic, readable branding with the required 'Drip Irrigation Tape' English and 'آبگسترافراپارسیان' Persian captions. The technical evidence is strong: the installed laterals are continuous and appropriately spaced for the crop. The required watermark 'AFP | 09134922013' is present and legible. Minor observations include slight contact between the tape and the crop bases and a small soil clearance gap, both of which are advisory and do not impact the overall quality. The product geometry is consistent with the reference, and there are no secondary objects, fake logos, or mixed families.

focused_physical_review.reason: The black irrigation line runs past the right side of the package but remains fully visible on the surface without disappearing underneath, crossing, or reappearing on the package's axis, so line_touches_or_crosses_package is false.  Soil is visible around the front and left sides, but the black line is clearly visible running along the back/right footprint with no broad uninterrupted soil gap behind it, so clear_soil_gap is false.  Only the one required white-and-blue AFP package is present and there is no separate loose coil, so extra_loose_product_coil is false.  No white ribbon, strap, or tape tail is visibly emerging from any side or the base of the carton, so package_has_protruding_strip is false.
